targets.outcome_quote: In a replication and extension of Field, Evans, and Orne's (1965) research, no support was found for the hypothesis that suggestion order is related to hypnotic responding. Confirming earlier findings, Ss were no more responsive to suggestions ordered from easy-to-difficult than they were to suggestions ordered from difficult-to-easy.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly says the null order effect confirms the earlier findings; no support for an order effect is agreement, rather than a failed replication.
